question: To what extent and of which pair should all the arts be worshipped?
premises: All arts are to be worshipped.
The worship extends down to the feet.
The arts belong to Kāma and Soma.
inference: One should worship all the arts of Kāma and Soma down to the feet.
plain_english: One should indeed worship all the arts of Kāma and Soma down to the feet.
